fields.statement: At fa3d982ee: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestHealthCI -v passes. In TestHealthCI, a record with one 'scripts (4/4) / UNKNOWN STEP' infra failure and one TestX flake gives ok/stable. Its detail lists 'flaky TestX: 1 flake' and 'infra scripts (4/4) / UNKNOWN STEP: 1 failure ... infra failures do not make CI unstable'. The stable summary comes from ciVerdict, which reads 'TestX was seen once and ignored; ignored infra failures: ...'. A record where TestX flaked on 2 heads gives warn, naming 'TestX flaked 2 times on 2 heads' and 'stops applying after'. TestHealthCIStability also passes. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/health-ci passes, and its script checks the infra line in both rhiza health and rhiza health --json. I read the diff: ciFailureCounts counts infra per job / step in the window, and healthCI appends one sorted infra detail line for each.
